correctness.rationale: The identity T²=0 is expanded in the basis (1,u,v,uv) and split by residue A. Nonzero A is a rank-one nilpotent; two 2-dimensional anticommutator kernels multiply to an element of the 2-dimensional image, giving a 6-dimensional affine lift fiber. At A=0, D is free and the base anticommuting-pair variety is classified by the trace/determinant of B in odd characteristic, or scalar/nonscalar centralizer dimension in characteristic two. Constant-rank bundles prove motivic classes and dimensions over arbitrary fields; exact brute-force verification produced full counts 1600 and 39609 for q=2,3 and base counts for q=2,3,5,7. No infinite claim rests solely on finite tests.

Prasad–Singla–Spallone work with radical length two; Chen–Wang classify the known field anticommuting-pair ingredient, not its nontrivial lift. The accessible historical dual-number result covers a strictly different ring. Searches and primary full-text comparisons revealed no result implying the complete theorem, with explicit residual risk of unlocated specialized literature.

value.rationale: Determines Grothendieck classes, dimensions and all finite-extension point counts of the square-zero free-module endomorphism locus over the smallest two-generator local complete intersection with nonzero second radical layer. The 9-to-10-dimensional characteristic jump follows from genuinely different commuting/anticommuting geometry rather than a trivial normalization check, and counts serve the natural arithmetic classification of differential structures on free modules.
